text.en: d. Active magnetic bearing systems.

text.zh: a. 具有两个或以上可同时协调进行“轮廓控制”的轴，且具有以下任一特性的车削机床：

text.zh: a.1. 沿一根或多根行程长度小于1.0 m的直线轴，“单向定位重复性”等于或小于（优于）0.9 µm；或

text.en: a.2. “Unidirectional positioning repeatability” equal to or less (better) than 1.1 µm along one or more linear axis with a travel length equal to or greater than 1.0 m;
Note 1:

text.zh: 2B001.a不管制为生产隐形眼镜“专门设计”且具有以下全部特性的车床：

text.zh: a. 机床控制器仅限于使用眼科“软件”输入零件编程数据；且
text.en: a. Machine controller limited to using ophthalmic based “software” for part programming data input; and

text.zh: b. 无真空夹持功能。
text.en: b. No vacuum chucking.
Note 2:

text.zh: 2B001.a不适用于仅限加工穿过式送料棒材的棒料机床（瑞士型车床），条件是最大棒材直径等于或小于42 mm，且不能安装卡盘。此类机床可具有对直径小于42 mm的零件进行钻削或铣削的能力。
text.en: 2B001.a does not apply to bar machines (Swissturn), limited to machining only bar feed thru, if maximum bar diameter is equal to or less than 42 mm and there is no capability of mounting chucks. Machines may have drilling or milling capabilities for machining parts with diameters less than 42 mm.

text.zh: b. 具有以下任一特性的铣削机床：
text.en: b. Machine tools for milling having any of the following:

text.zh: b.1. 具有三个直线轴加一个旋转轴，可同时协调进行“轮廓控制”，且具有以下任一特性：
text.en: b.1. Three linear axes plus one rotary axis which can be coordinated simultaneously for “contouring control” having any of the following:

text.zh: b.1.a. 沿一根或多根行程长度小于1.0 m的直线轴，“单向定位重复性”等于或小于（优于）0.9 µm；或
text.en: b.1.a. “Unidirectional positioning repeatability” equal to or less (better) than 0.9 µm along one or more linear axis with a travel length less than 1.0 m; or

text.zh: b.1.b. 沿一根或多根行程长度等于或大于1.0 m的直线轴，“单向定位重复性”等于或小于（优于）1.1 µm；
text.en: b.1.b. “Unidirectional positioning repeatability” equal to or less (better) than 1.1 µm along one or more linear axis with a travel length equal to or greater than 1.0 m;

text.zh: b.2. 具有五个或以上可同时协调进行“轮廓控制”的轴，且具有以下任一特性：
text.en: b.2. Five or more axes which can be coordinated simultaneously for “contouring control” having any of the following:

text.zh: b.2.a. 沿一根或多根行程长度小于1.0 m的直线轴，“单向定位重复性”等于或小于（优于）0.9 µm；
text.en: b.2.a. “Unidirectional positioning repeatability” equal to or less (better) than 0.9 µm along one or more linear axis with a travel length less than 1.0 m;

text.zh: b.2.b. 沿一根或多根行程长度等于或大于1 m且小于4 m的直线轴，“单向定位重复性”等于或小于（优于）1.4 µm；或
text.en: b.2.b. “Unidirectional positioning repeatability” equal to or less (better) than 1.4 µm along one or more linear axis with a travel length equal to or greater than 1 m and less than 4 m; or

text.zh: b.2.c. 沿一根或多根行程长度等于或大于4 m的直线轴，“单向定位重复性”等于或小于（优于）6.0 µm；
text.en: b.2.c. “Unidirectional positioning repeatability” equal to or less (better) than 6.0 µm along one or more linear axis with a travel length equal to or greater than 4 m;

text.zh: b.3. 坐标镗床沿一根或多根直线轴的“单向定位重复性”等于或小于（优于）1.1 µm；或
text.en: b.3. A “unidirectional positioning repeatability” for jig boring machines, equal to or less (better) than 1.1 µm along one or more linear axis; or

text.zh: b.4. 具有以下全部特性的飞刀切削机床：
text.en: b.4. Fly cutting machines having all of the following:

text.zh: b.4.a. 主轴的径向“跳动”和轴向“窜动”小于（优于）0.0004 mm总指示读数（TIR）；且
text.en: b.4.a. Spindle “run-out” and “camming” less (better) than 0.0004 mm TIR; and

text.zh: b.4.b. 在300 mm行程内，滑座运动的角偏差（偏航、俯仰及滚转）小于（优于）2角秒（TIR）；
text.en: b.4.b. Angular deviation of slide movement (yaw, pitch and roll) less (better) than 2 seconds of arc, TIR, over 300 mm of travel;

text.en: c.2.b. “Unidirectional positioning repeatability” equal to or less (better) than 1.4 µm along one or more linear axis with a travel length equal to or greater than 1 m and less than 4 m; or

text.zh: c.2.c. 沿一根或多根行程长度等于或大于4 m的直线轴，“单向定位重复性”等于或小于（优于）6.0 µm。
text.en: c.2.c. “Unidirectional positioning repeatability” equal to or less (better) than 6.0 µm along one or more linear axis with a travel length equal to or greater than 4 m.

text.en: 2B001.c does not control grinding machines as follows:

text.en: e.1. Removing material by means of any of the following:

text.zh: e.1.a. 水射流或其他液体射流，包括采用磨料添加剂的射流；
text.en: e.1.a. Water or other liquid jets, including those employing abrasive additives;

text.zh: e.1.b. 电子束；或

text.zh: e.1.c. “激光”束；且
text.en: e.1.c. “Laser” beam; and

text.zh: e.2. 至少具有两个同时满足以下全部条件的旋转轴：
text.en: e.2. At least two rotary axes having all of the following:

text.zh: e.2.a. 可同时协调进行“轮廓控制”；且
text.en: e.2.a. Can be coordinated simultaneously for “contouring control”; and

text.zh: e.2.b. 定位“精度”小于（优于）0.003°；
text.en: e.2.b. A positioning “accuracy” of less (better) than 0.003°;

text.zh: f. 最大钻孔深度能力超过5m的深孔钻床及改装用于深孔钻削的车床。
text.en: f. Deep-hole-drilling machines and turning machines modified for deep-hole-drilling, having a maximum depth-of-bore capability exceeding 5m.

text.zh: 相关定义：就2B002而言，“MRF”是采用含磨料磁流体去除材料的工艺，其黏度由磁场控制。“ERF”是采用含磨料流体去除材料的工艺，其黏度由电场控制。“高能粒子束精加工”采用反应原子等离子体（RAP）或离子束选择性去除材料。“充气薄膜工具精加工”是采用受压薄膜发生变形并以小面积接触工件的工艺。“流体射流精加工”利用流体流束去除材料。
text.en: Related Definitions: For the purposes of 2B002, ‘MRF’ is a material removal process using an abrasive magnetic fluid whose viscosity is controlled by a magnetic field. ‘ERF’ is a removal process using an abrasive fluid whose viscosity is controlled by an electric field. ‘Energetic particle beam finishing’ uses Reactive Atom Plasmas (RAP) or ion-beams to selectively remove material. ‘Inflatable membrane tool finishing’ is a process that uses a pressurized membrane that deforms to contact the workpiece over a small area.'Fluid jet finishing’ makes use of a fluid stream for material removal.

text.zh: 物项：

text.zh: a. 计算机控制或“数控”的坐标测量机（CMM），根据ISO 10360-2（2009），在机床工作范围内任一点（即各轴长度范围内），三维长度（空间）测量的最大允许误差（E_{0,MPE}）等于或小于（优于）（1.7 + L/1,000）µm（L为以mm计的测量长度）；
text.en: a. Computer controlled or “numerically controlled” Coordinate Measuring Machines (CMM), having a three dimensional length (volumetric) maximum permissible error of length measurement (E_{0,MPE}) at any point within the operating range of the machine (i.e., within the length of axes) equal to or less (better) than (1.7 + L/1,000) µm (L is the measured length in mm) according to ISO 10360-2 (2009);

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 就2B006.a而言，应将制造商规定的CMM最精确配置（例如以下因素的最佳组合：测头、测针长度、运动参数、环境）并启用“所有可用补偿”时的E_{0,MPE}，与1.7 + L/1,000 µm阈值进行比较。
text.en: For the purposes of 2B006.a, E_{0,MPE} of the most accurate configuration of the CMM specified by the manufacturer (e.g.,best of the following: Probe, stylus length, motion parameters, environment) and with “all compensations available” shall be compared to the 1.7 + L/1,000 µm threshold.

text.zh: b. 如下直线位移测量仪器或系统、直线位置反馈单元及“电子组件”：
text.en: b. Linear displacement measuring instruments or systems, linear position feedback units, and “electronic assemblies”, as follows:

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 含“激光”的干涉仪和光学编码器测量系统仅由2B006.b.3列明。
text.en: Interferometer and optical-encoder measuring systems containing a “laser” are only specified by 2B006.b.3.

text.zh: b.1. 在“测量范围”的0至0.2 mm范围内，“分辨率”等于或小于（优于）0.2 µm的“非接触式测量系统”；
text.en: b.1. 'Non-contact type measuring systems' with a 'resolution' equal to or less (better) than 0.2 µm within 0 to 0.2 mm of the 'measuring range';

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Notes:
For the purposes of 2B006.b.1:

text.zh: 1. “非接触式测量系统”设计用于在测头或被测物体运动时，沿单一矢量测量测头与被测物体之间的距离。
text.en: 1. 'Non-contact type measuring systems' are designed to measure the distance between the probe and measured object along a single vector, where the probe or measured object is in motion.

text.zh: 2. “测量范围”指最小与最大工作距离之差。
text.en: 2. 'Measuring range' means the distance between the minimum and maximum working distance.

text.zh: b.2. 为机床“专门设计”，且总“精度”小于（优于）（800 +（600 × L/1,000））nm的直线位置反馈单元（L为以mm计的有效长度）；
text.en: b.2. Linear position feedback units “specially designed” for machine tools and having an overall “accuracy” less (better) than (800 + (600 × L/1,000)) nm (L equals effective length in mm);

text.zh: b.3. 具有以下全部特性的测量系统：
text.en: b.3. Measuring systems having all of the following:

text.zh: b.3.a. 含有“激光”；
text.en: b.3.a. Containing a “laser”;

text.zh: b.3.b. 全量程“分辨率”为0.200 nm或以下（更优）；且
text.en: b.3.b. A 'resolution' over their full scale of 0.200 nm or less (better); and

text.zh: b.3.c. 在对空气折射率进行补偿，并在20±0.01 °C温度下测量30秒时，能够在测量范围内任一点达到等于或小于（优于）（1.6 + L/2,000）nm的“测量不确定度”（L为以mm计的测量长度）；
text.en: b.3.c. Capable of achieving a “measurement uncertainty” equal to or less (better) than (1.6 + L/2,000) nm (L is the measured length in mm) at any point within a measuring range, when compensated for the refractive index of air and measured over a period of 30 seconds at a temperature of 20±0.01 °C;

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 相关定义：配备数字控制器的振动试验系统，是指其功能全部或部分由存储的数字编码电信号自动控制的系统。
text.en: Related Definitions: Vibration test systems incorporating a digital controller are those systems, the functions of which are, partly or entirely, automatically controlled by stored and digitally coded electrical signals.

text.zh: 物项：a. 采用反馈或闭环技术并配备数字控制器的振动试验系统，能够在20 Hz至2,000 Hz之间，使系统以等于或大于10 g rms的加速度振动，同时施加以“空台”测量等于或大于50 kN（11,250磅）的力；
text.en: Items: a. Vibration test systems employing feedback or closed loop techniques and incorporating a digital controller, capable of vibrating a system at an acceleration equal to or greater than 10 g rms between 20 Hz to 2,000 Hz while imparting forces equal to or greater than 50 kN (11,250 lbs.), measured ‘bare table’;

text.zh: b. 与“专门设计”的振动试验“软件”配合使用、“实时控制带宽”大于5 kHz，且设计用于2B116.a所述振动试验系统的数字控制器；
text.en: b. Digital controllers, combined with “specially designed” vibration test “software”, with a ‘real-time control bandwidth’ greater than 5 kHz and designed for use with vibration test systems described in 2B116.a;

text.zh: c. 无论是否配有相关放大器，以“空台”测量能够施加等于或大于50 kN（11,250磅）的力，且可用于2B116.a所述振动试验系统的振动推力装置（振动器单元）；
text.en: c. Vibration thrusters (shaker units), with or without associated amplifiers, capable of imparting a force equal to or greater than 50 kN (11,250 lbs.), measured ‘bare table’, and usable in vibration test systems described in 2B116.a;

text.zh: d. 设计用于将多个振动器单元组合成完整振动系统的试件支撑结构和电子单元，该系统以“空台”测量能够提供等于或大于50 kN的有效合力，且可用于2B116.a所述振动试验系统。
text.en: d. Test piece support structures and electronic units designed to combine multiple shaker units into a complete shaker system capable of providing an effective combined force equal to or greater than 50 kN, measured ‘bare table’, and usable in vibration test systems described in 2B116.a.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Notes:

text.zh: （1）“空台”指没有任何夹具或配件的平坦台面或表面。
text.en: (1) ‘Bare table’ means a flat table, or surface, with no fixture or fitting.

text.zh: （2）“实时控制带宽”定义为控制器能够执行采样、处理数据和传输控制信号完整循环的最大速率。
text.en: (2) ‘Real-time control bandwidth’ is defined as the maximum rate at which a controller can execute complete cycles of sampling, processing data and transmitting control signals.

text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 本条目所列定位精度值基于ISO 230/2（2006），等同于核供应国集团（NSG）所采用的基于ISO 230/2（1988）的数值。在2B201.a和.b.1中，由此产生的变化是从6 µm改为4.5 µm；在2B201.b注释的.b项中，从30 µm改为22.5 µm；在2B201.c中，从4 µm改为3 µm。
text.en: The identified positioning accuracy values in this entry are based on ISO 230/2 (2006), which equates to the values based on ISO 230/2 (1988) that are used by the Nuclear Supplier's Group (NSG). In 2B201.a and .b.1, this results in a change from 6 µm to 4.5 µm. In paragraph .b of the Note to 2B201.b, the resulting change is from 30 µm to 22.5 µm, In 2B201.c, the resulting change is from 4 µm to 3 µm.

text.zh: a. 能加工直径大于35 mm的工件，且根据ISO 230/2（2006），在启用所有可用补偿时，沿任一直线轴的定位精度（总定位）优于（小于）4.5 µm的车削机床；
text.en: a. Machine tools for turning, that have positioning accuracies according to ISO 230/2 (2006) with all compensations available better (less) than 4.5 µm along any linear axis (overall positioning) for machines capable of machining diameters greater than 35 mm;
Note to 2B201.a:

text.zh: 2B201.a不管制仅限加工穿过式送料棒材的棒料机床（瑞士型车床），条件是最大棒材直径等于或小于42 mm，且不能安装卡盘。此类机床可具有对直径小于42 mm的零件进行钻削和/或铣削的能力。
text.en: 2B201.a does not control bar machines (Swissturn), limited to machining only bar feed thru, if maximum bar diameter is equal to or less than 42 mm and there is no capability of mounting chucks. Machines may have drilling and/or milling capabilities for machining parts with diameters less than 42 mm.

text.zh: b. 具有以下任一特性的铣削机床：
text.en: b. Machine tools for milling, having any of the following characteristics:

text.zh: b.1. 根据ISO 230/2（2006），在启用“所有可用补偿”时，沿任一直线轴的定位精度（总定位）等于或小于（优于）4.5 µm；
text.en: b.1. Positioning accuracies according to ISO 230/2 (2006) with “all compensations available” equal to or less (better) than 4.5 µm along any linear axis (overall positioning);

text.zh: b.2. 具有两个或以上轮廓控制旋转轴；或
text.en: b.2. Two or more contouring rotary axes; or

text.zh: b.3. 具有五个或以上可同时协调进行“轮廓控制”的轴。
text.en: b.3. Five or more axes which can be coordinated simultaneously for “contouring control.”
Note to 2B201.b:

text.zh: 2B201.b不管制具有以下特性的铣床：
text.en: 2B201.b does not control milling machines having the following characteristics:

text.zh: a. X轴行程大于2 m；且
text.en: a. X-axis travel greater than 2 m; and

text.zh: b. 根据ISO 230/2（2006），x轴的总定位精度大于（差于）22.5 µm。
text.en: b. Overall positioning accuracy according to ISO 230/2 (2006) on the x-axis more (worse) than 22.5 µm.

text.zh: c. 具有以下任一特性的磨削机床：
text.en: c. Machine tools for grinding, having any of the following characteristics:

text.zh: c.1. 根据ISO 230/2（2006），在启用“所有可用补偿”时，沿任一直线轴的定位精度（总定位）等于或小于（优于）3 µm；
text.en: c.1. Positioning accuracies according to ISO 230/2 (2006) with “all compensations available” equal to or less (better) than 3 µm along any linear axis (overall positioning);

text.zh: c.2. 具有两个或以上轮廓控制旋转轴；或
text.en: c.2. Two or more contouring rotary axes; or

text.zh: c.3. 具有五个或以上可同时协调进行“轮廓控制”的轴。
text.en: c.3. Five or more axes which can be coordinated simultaneously for “contouring control.”
Note to 2B201.c:

text.zh: 2B201.c不管制以下磨床：
text.en: 2B201.c does not control the following grinding machines:

text.zh: a. 具有以下全部特性的外圆、内圆及内外圆磨床：
text.en: a. Cylindrical external, internal, and external-internal grinding machines having all of the following characteristics:

text.zh: 1. 最大工件加工能力仅限于外径或长度150 mm；且
text.en: 1. Limited to a maximum workpiece capacity of 150 mm outside diameter or length; and

text.zh: 2. 轴仅限于x、z和c。
text.en: 2. Axes limited to x, z and c.

text.zh: b. 不具有z轴或w轴，且总定位精度小于（优于）3微米的坐标磨床。定位精度按ISO 230/2（2006）确定。
text.en: b. Jig grinders that do not have a z-axis or a w-axis with an overall positioning accuracy less (better) than 3 microns. Positioning accuracy is according to ISO 230/2 (2006).

text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 2B201.b.3和c.3包括基于并联直线运动学设计（例如六足平台）、具有5个或以上轴且所有轴均非旋转轴的机床。

text.zh: ECCN 2B206管制注释：
text.en: Control Notes to ECCN 2B206:

text.zh: （1）可用作测量机的机床，如达到或超过本条目针对测量机功能规定的管制参数，则由ECCN 2B206管制。（2）ECCN 2B206所述机器，如在其工作范围内任何位置超过规定的管制阈值，即由本条目管制。
text.en: (1) Machine tools that can be used as measuring machines are controlled by ECCN 2B206 if they meet or exceed the control parameters specified in this entry for the measuring machine function. (2) The machines described in ECCN 2B206 are controlled by this entry if they exceed the specified control threshold anywhere in their operating range.

text.zh: ECCN 2B206技术注释：
text.en: Technical Note to ECCN 2B206:

text.zh: 本条目中的所有测量值参数均表示正/负值，而非总范围。
text.en: All parameters of measurement values in this entry represent plus/minus, i.e., not total band.

text.zh: a. 具有以下任一特性的计算机控制或数控坐标测量机（CMM）：
text.en: a. Computer controlled or numerically controlled coordinate measuring machines (CMM) with either of the following characteristics:

text.zh: a.1. 仅有两个轴，根据ISO 10360-2（2009），在机器工作范围内任一点（即轴长范围内），沿任一轴（一维）的长度测量最大允许误差（以E_{0x MPE}、E_{0y MPE}或E_{0z MPE}的任意组合表示）等于或小于（优于）（1.25 + L/1,000）µm（L为以mm计的测量长度）；或
text.en: a.1. Having only two axes with a maximum permissible error of length measurement along any axis (one dimension), identified as any combination of E_{0x MPE}, E_{0y MPE} or E_{0z MPE}, equal to or less (better) than (1.25 + L/1,000) µm (where L is the measured length in mm) at any point within the operating range of the machine (i.e., within the length of the axis), according to ISO 10360-2 (2009); or

text.zh: a.2. 具有三个或以上轴，根据ISO 10360-2（2009），在机器工作范围内任一点（即轴长范围内），三维（空间）长度测量最大允许误差（表示为E_{0},_{MPE}）等于或小于（优于）（1.7 + L/800）µm（L为以mm计的测量长度）。
text.en: a.2. Having three or more axes with a three dimensional (volumetric) maximum permissible error of length measurement, identified as E_{0},_{MPE}, equal to or less (better) than (1.7 + L/800) µm (where L is the measured length in mm) at any point within the operating range of the machine (i.e., within the length of the axis), according to ISO 10360-2 (2009).

text.zh: 2B206.a.2技术注释：
text.en: Technical Note to 2B206.a.2:

text.zh: 应将制造商依ISO 10360-2（2009）规定的CMM最精确配置（例如以下因素的最佳组合：测头、测针长度、运动参数、环境）并启用所有可用补偿时的E_{0},_{MPE}，与1.7 + L/800 µm阈值进行比较。
text.en: The E_{0},_{MPE} of the most accurate configuration of the CMM specified according to ISO 10360-2 (2009) by the manufacturer (e.g., best of the following: Probe, stylus length, motion parameters, environment) and with all compensations available shall be compared to the 1.7 + L/800 µm threshold.

text.zh: b. 同时具有以下两项特性的半球壳直线-角度同步检验系统：
text.en: b. Systems for simultaneous linear-angular inspection of hemishells, having both of the following characteristics:

text.zh: b.1. 沿任一直线轴的“测量不确定度”等于或小于（优于）每5 mm为3.5 µm；且
text.en: b.1. “Measurement uncertainty” along any linear axis equal to or less (better) than 3.5 µm per 5 mm; and

text.zh: b.2. “角位置偏差”等于或小于0.02°。
text.en: b.2. “Angular position deviation” equal to or less than 0.02°.

text.zh: c. 同时具有以下两项特性的直线位移测量系统：

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Notes:

text.zh: 1. 在涡旋式压缩机或真空泵中，月牙形气腔形成于一对或多对相互啮合的螺旋叶片（涡旋盘）之间，其中一个运动，另一个保持静止。动涡旋盘绕静涡旋盘公转而不自转。随着动涡旋盘绕静涡旋盘公转，气腔向机器出口移动，其体积逐渐减小（即被压缩）。
text.en: 1. In a scroll compressor or vacuum pump, crescent-shaped pockets of gas are trapped between one or more pairs of intermeshed spiral vanes, or scrolls, one of which moves while the other remains stationary. The moving scroll orbits the stationary scroll; it does not rotate. As the moving scroll orbits the stationary scroll, the gas pockets diminish in size (i.e., they are compressed) as they move toward the outlet port of the machine.

text.en: h.7. Zirconium or zirconium alloys;

text.zh: h.8. 铌或铌合金；或
text.en: h.8. Niobium (columbium) or niobium alloys; or

text.zh: h.9. 石墨或碳-石墨。
text.en: h.9. Graphite or carbon-graphite.

text.zh: i. 制造商规定最大流量大于0.6 m^{3}/小时（600升/小时）的多重密封泵和无密封泵，或制造商规定最大流量大于5 m^{3}/小时（5,000升/小时）的真空泵（在标准温度273 K（0 °C）和压力101.3 kPa条件下），以及为此类泵设计的壳体（泵体）、预制壳体衬里、叶轮、转子或射流泵喷嘴，其与所加工化学品直接接触的所有表面均由以下任一材料制成：
text.en: i. Multiple-seal and seal-less pumps with manufacturer's specified maximum flow-rate greater than 0.6 m^{3}/hour (600 liters/hour), or vacuum pumps with manufacturer's specified maximum flow-rate greater than 5 m^{3}/hour (5,000 liters/hour) (under standard temperature (273 K (0 °C)) and pressure (101.3 kPa) conditions), and casings (pump bodies), preformed casing liners, impellers, rotors or jet pump nozzles designed for such pumps, in which all surfaces that come into direct contact with the chemical(s) being processed are made from any of the following materials:

text.zh: i.1. 按重量计镍含量超过25%且铬含量超过20%的合金；
text.en: i.1. Alloys with more than 25% nickel and 20% chromium by weight;

text.zh: i.2. 镍或按重量计镍含量超过40%的合金；
text.en: i.2. Nickel or alloys with more than 40% nickel by weight;

text.zh: i.3. 含氟聚合物（按重量计氟含量超过35%的聚合物或弹性体材料）；
text.en: i.3. Fluoropolymers (polymeric or elastomeric materials with more than 35% fluorine by weight);

text.zh: i.4. 玻璃（包括玻璃化或搪瓷涂层或玻璃衬里）；
text.en: i.4. Glass (including vitrified or enameled coatings or glass lining);

text.zh: i.5. 钽或钽合金；
text.en: i.5. Tantalum or tantalum alloys;

text.zh: i.6. 钛或钛合金；
text.en: i.6. Titanium or titanium alloys;

text.zh: i.7. 锆或锆合金；
text.en: i.7. Zirconium or zirconium alloys;

text.zh: i.8. 铌或铌合金。
text.en: i.8. Niobium (columbium) or niobium alloys.

text.zh: i.9. 石墨或碳-石墨；
text.en: i.9. Graphite or carbon-graphite;

text.zh: i.10. 陶瓷；或
text.en: i.10. Ceramics; or

text.zh: i.11. 硅铁（高硅铁合金）。
text.en: i.11. Ferrosilicon (high silicon iron alloys).

text.zh: 2B350.i技术注释：
text.en: Technical Note to 2B350.i:

text.zh: 2B350.i所指密封件与所加工化学品直接接触（或设计用于此种接触），并在旋转或往复式驱动轴穿过泵体的位置提供密封功能。
text.en: The seals referred to in 2B350.i come into direct contact with the chemical(s) being processed (or are designed to do so), and provide a sealing function where a rotary or reciprocating drive shaft passes through a pump body.

text.zh: j. 设计用于销毁化学战剂、1C350管制的化学武器前体或化学弹药的焚烧炉，具有“专门设计”的废物供给系统、特殊处理设施，且燃烧室平均温度大于1000 °C；其废物供给系统中与废物直接接触的所有表面均由以下任一材料制成或衬里：
text.en: j. Incinerators designed to destroy chemical warfare agents, chemical weapons precursors controlled by 1C350, or chemical munitions having “specially designed” waste supply systems, special handling facilities and an average combustion chamber temperature greater than 1000 °C in which all surfaces in the waste supply system that come into direct contact with the waste products are made from or lined with any of the following materials:

text.zh: j.1. 按重量计镍含量超过25%且铬含量超过20%的合金；
text.en: j.1. Alloys with more than 25% nickel and 20% chromium by weight;

text.zh: j.2. 镍或按重量计镍含量超过40%的合金；或
text.en: j.2. Nickel or alloys with more than 40% nickel by weight; or

text.zh: j.3. 陶瓷。
text.en: j.3. Ceramics.

text.zh: 技术注释1：
text.en: Technical Note 1:

text.zh: 碳-石墨是主要由石墨和无定形碳组成的材料，其中石墨占该组合物重量的8%或以上。
text.en: Carbon-graphite is a composition consisting primarily of graphite and amorphous carbon, in which the graphite is 8 percent or more by weight of the composition.

text.zh: 技术注释2：
text.en: Technical Note 2:

text.zh: 对于2B350所列物项，“合金”一词如未附具体元素浓度，是指所标明金属的重量百分比高于任何其他元素的合金。
text.en: For the items listed in 2B350, the term 'alloy,' when not accompanied by a specific elemental concentration, is understood as identifying those alloys where the identified metal is present in a higher percentage by weight than any other element.

text.zh: 技术注释3：
text.en: Technical Note 3:

text.zh: 用于垫片、填料、密封件、螺钉或垫圈的材料，或其他发挥密封功能的材料，不决定本ECCN物项的管制状态，但前提是这些部件设计为可互换。
text.en: The materials used for gaskets, packing, seals, screws or washers, or other materials performing a sealing function, do not determine the control status of the items in this ECCN, provided that such components are designed to be interchangeable.

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 所有“受ITAR管辖”的化学品见《美国军品清单》第V和第XIV类（见22 CFR Parts 120至130）。
text.en: See Categories V and XIV of the United States Munitions List for all chemicals that are “subject to the ITAR” (see 22 CFR parts 120 through 130).

text.zh: 相关管制：本ECCN管制的有毒气体监测器和监测系统及其专用检测“零件”和“部件”的“软件”见ECCN 2D351。另见ECCN 1A004：该条目管制为探测或识别化学战剂“专门设计”或改装、但并非为军事用途“专门设计”的化学检测系统及其“专门设计”的“零件”和“部件”；以及ECCN 1A995：该条目管制不受ECCN 1A004或本ECCN管制的某些检测设备、“零件”和“部件”。
text.en: Related Controls: See ECCN 2D351 for “software” for toxic gas monitors and monitoring systems, and their dedicated detecting “parts” and “components,” controlled by this ECCN. Also see ECCN 1A004, which controls chemical detection systems and “specially designed” “parts” and “components” therefor that are “specially designed” or modified for detection or identification of chemical warfare agents, but not “specially designed” for military use, and ECCN 1A995, which controls certain detection equipment, “parts” and “components” not controlled by ECCN 1A004 or by this ECCN.

text.zh: 相关定义：（1）就本条目而言，“专用”指完全专用于单一用途或装置。（2）就本条目而言，“连续运行”描述设备无需人工干预即可在线运行的能力。本条目旨在管制能够在化工厂等环境中采集和检测样品的有毒气体监测器和监测系统，而非实验室中用于分批操作的设备。
text.en: Related Definitions: (1) For the purposes of this entry, the term “dedicated” means committed entirely to a single purpose or device. (2) For the purposes of this entry, the term “continuous operation” describes the capability of the equipment to operate on line without human intervention. The intent of this entry is to control toxic gas monitors and monitoring systems capable of collection and detection of samples in environments such as chemical plants, rather than those used for batch-mode operation in laboratories.

text.zh: 物项：
text.en: Items:

text.zh: a. 设计用于连续运行，能够探测化学战剂或1C350管制的前体化学品，“最低检出限”为0.3 mg/m^{3}；或
text.en: a. Designed for continuous operation and usable for the detection of chemical warfare agents or precursor chemicals controlled by 1C350 'minimum detection limit' of 0.3 mg/m^{3}; or

text.zh: b. 设计用于检测胆碱酯酶抑制活性。
text.en: b. Designed for the detection of cholinesterase-inhibiting activity.

text.zh: 技术注释：
text.en: Technical note:

text.zh: 有毒气体监测器或监测系统的“最低检出限”，是指产生的信号大于该监测器或系统测量空白样品时信号标准偏差三倍所需的最低可检测分析物浓度。
text.en: The 'minimum detection limit' of toxic gas monitors or monitoring systems is the lowest detectable concentration of the analyte required to produce a signal greater than three times the standard deviation of the toxic gas monitor's or monitoring system's signal when measuring a blank sample.

text.zh: 对于具有死区或程序化零点抑制的有毒气体监测器或监测系统，“最低检出限”指产生读数所需的最低可检测浓度。
text.en: In the case of toxic gas monitors or monitoring systems having a deadband or programmed zero suppression, the 'minimum detection limit' is the lowest detectable concentration required to produce a reading.

Also see ECCN 9A120 for controls on certain “UAV” systems designed or modified to dispense an aerosol and capable of carrying elements of a payload in the form of a particulate or liquid, other than fuel “parts” or “components” of such vehicles, of a volume greater than 20 liters.

text.zh: 相关定义：（1）“轻于空气的飞行器”——依靠热空气或氦、氢等轻于空气的气体获得升力的气球和飞艇。（2）“UAVs”——无人航空器。（3）“VMD”——体积中位直径。
text.en: Related Definitions: (1) “Lighter than air vehicles”—balloons and airships that rely on hot air or on lighter-than-air gases, such as helium or hydrogen, for their lift. (2) “UAVs”—Unmanned Aerial Vehicles. (3) “VMD”—Volume Median Diameter.

text.zh: 物项：
text.en: Items:

text.zh: a. 如下密闭设施及相关设备：
text.en: a. Containment facilities and related equipment, as follows:

text.zh: a.1. P3或P4密闭等级的完整密闭设施。
text.en: a.1. Complete containment facilities at P3 or P4 containment level.

text.zh: 2B352.a.1技术注释：
text.en: Technical Note to 2B352.a.1:

text.zh: P3或P4（BL3、BL4、L3、L4）密闭等级按世界卫生组织《实验室生物安全手册》（第3版，日内瓦，2004年）规定。
text.en: P3 or P4 (BL3, BL4, L3, L4) containment levels are as specified in the WHO Laboratory Biosafety Manual (3rd edition, Geneva, 2004).

text.zh: a.2. 设计用于固定安装在本ECCN a.1项所列密闭设施中的如下设备：
text.en: a.2. Equipment designed for fixed installation in containment facilities specified in paragraph a.1 of this ECCN, as follows:

text.zh: a.2.a. 双门贯通式去污高压灭菌器；
text.en: a.2.a. Double-door pass-through decontamination autoclaves;

text.zh: a.2.b. 呼吸供气防护服去污淋浴装置；
text.en: a.2.b. Breathing air suit decontamination showers;

text.zh: a.2.c. 机械密封或充气密封通行门。
text.en: a.2.c. Mechanical-seal or inflatable-seal walkthrough doors.

text.zh: b. 如下发酵罐及部件：
text.en: b. Fermenters and components as follows:

text.zh: b.1. 能在不扩散气溶胶的情况下培养微生物，或培养活细胞以生产病毒或毒素，且内部总体积为20升或以上的发酵罐。
text.en: b.1. Fermenters capable of cultivation of micro-organisms or of live cells for the production of viruses or toxins, without the propagation of aerosols, having a total internal volume of 20 liters or greater.

text.zh: b.2. 为此类发酵罐设计的如下部件：
text.en: b.2. Components designed for such fermenters, as follows:

text.zh: b.2.a. 设计可进行原位灭菌或消毒的培养室；
text.en: b.2.a. Cultivation chambers designed to be sterilized or disinfected in situ;

text.zh: b.2.b. 培养室支撑装置；或
text.en: b.2.b. Cultivation chamber holding devices; or

text.zh: b.2.c. 能同时监测和控制两个或以上发酵系统参数（例如温度、pH、营养物、搅拌、溶解氧、气流、泡沫控制）的过程控制单元。
text.en: b.2.c. Process control units capable of simultaneously monitoring and controlling two or more fermentation system parameters (e.g., temperature, pH, nutrients, agitation, dissolved oxygen, air flow, foam control).

text.zh: 2B352.b技术注释：
text.en: Technical Notes to 2B352.b:

text.zh: 1. 发酵罐包括生物反应器（包括一次性生物反应器）、恒化器和连续流系统。
text.en: 1. Fermenters include bioreactors (including single-use (disposable) bioreactors), chemostats and continuous-flow systems.

text.zh: 2. 2B352.b.2.b管制的培养室支撑装置包括具有刚性壁的一次性培养室。
text.en: 2. Cultivation chamber holding devices controlled by 2B352.b.2.b include single-use cultivation chambers with rigid walls.

text.zh: c. 能在不扩散气溶胶的情况下连续分离、流量大于每小时100升的如下离心分离机：
text.en: c. Centrifugal separators capable of continuous separation, without the propagation of aerosols, having a flow rate greater than 100 liters per hour, as follows:

text.zh: c.1. 具有以下全部特性的离心分离机：
text.en: c.1. Centrifugal separators having all of the following characteristics:

text.zh: c.1.a. 蒸汽密闭区域内具有一个或多个密封接头；
text.en: c.1.a. One or more sealing joints within the steam containment area;

text.zh: c.1.b. 部件由抛光不锈钢或钛制成；且
text.en: c.1.b. Components of polished stainless steel or titanium; and

text.zh: c.1.c. 能在封闭状态下进行原位蒸汽灭菌。
text.en: c.1.c. Capable of in-situ steam sterilization in a closed state.

text.zh: c.2. 一次性离心分离机，其与所加工物质直接接触的所有部件均为用后弃置或单次使用。
text.en: c.2. Single-use centrifugal separators, in which all components that come in direct contact with the substances being processed are disposable or single-use.

text.zh: 2B352.c技术注释：
text.en: Technical Note to 2B352.c:

text.zh: 离心分离机和一次性离心分离机包括卧式螺旋沉降离心机。
text.en: Centrifugal separators and single-use centrifugal separators include decanters.

text.zh: d. 如下交叉流（切向流）过滤设备及“附件”：
text.en: d. Cross (tangential) flow filtration equipment and “accessories”, as follows:

text.zh: d.1. 能分离微生物、病毒、毒素或细胞培养物，且具有以下全部特性的交叉流（切向流）过滤设备：
text.en: d.1. Cross (tangential) flow filtration equipment capable of separation of microorganisms, viruses, toxins or cell cultures having all of the following characteristics:

text.zh: d.1.a. 总过滤面积等于或大于1平方米（1 m^{2}）；且
text.en: d.1.a. A total filtration area equal to or greater than 1 square meter (1 m^{2}); and

text.zh: d.1.b. 具有以下任一特性：
text.en: d.1.b. Having any of the following characteristics:

text.zh: d.1.b.1. 能进行原位灭菌或消毒；或
text.en: d.1.b.1. Capable of being sterilized or disinfected in-situ; or

text.zh: d.1.b.2. 使用用后弃置或单次使用的过滤“零件”或“部件”。
text.en: d.1.b.2. Using disposable or single-use filtration “parts” or “components”.

text.zh: 注意：
text.en: N.B.:

text.zh: 2B352.d.1不管制制造商标明的反渗透及血液透析设备。
text.en: 2B352.d.1 does not control reverse osmosis and hemodialysis equipment, as specified by the manufacturer.

text.zh: d.2. 每个“零件”或“部件”的过滤面积等于或大于0.2平方米（0.2 m^{2}），且设计用于2B352.d.1管制交叉流（切向流）过滤设备的交叉流（切向流）过滤“零件”或“部件”（例如模块、元件、膜包、滤芯、单元或板）。
text.en: d.2. Cross (tangential) flow filtration “parts” or “components” (e.g., modules, elements, cassettes, cartridges, units or plates) with filtration area equal to or greater than 0.2 square meters (0.2 m^{2}) for each “part” or “component” and designed for use in cross (tangential) flow filtration equipment controlled by 2B352.d.1.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 在本ECCN中，“灭菌”指通过物理方式（例如蒸汽）或化学剂消除设备中的所有存活微生物。“消毒”指通过化学剂减少微生物数量（通常不包括细菌芽孢）的过程，不一定杀灭或去除所有生物体。
text.en: In this ECCN, “sterilized” denotes the elimination of all viable microbes from the equipment through the use of either physical (e.g., steam) or chemical agents. “Disinfected” denotes a process to reduce the number of microorganisms, but not usually of bacterial spores, through the use of chemical agents, without necessarily killing or removing all organisms.

text.zh: e. 可用蒸汽、气体或蒸气灭菌的冷冻干燥设备，其冷凝器容量为24小时内10 kg冰或以上（24小时内10升水或以上），且小于24小时内1000 kg冰（小于24小时内1,000升水）。
text.en: e. Steam, gas or vapor sterilizable freeze-drying equipment with a condenser capacity of 10 kg of ice or greater in 24 hours (10 liters of water or greater in 24 hours) and less than 1000 kg of ice in 24 hours (less than 1,000 liters of water in 24 hours).

text.zh: f. 能干燥毒素或病原微生物，且具有以下全部特性的喷雾干燥设备：
text.en: f. Spray-drying equipment capable of drying toxins or pathogenic microorganisms having all of the following characteristics:

text.zh: f.1. 水蒸发能力≥0.4 kg/h且≤400 kg/h；
text.en: f.1. A water evaporation capacity of ≥0.4 kg/h and ≤400 kg/h;

text.zh: f.2. 使用现有配件，或对喷雾干燥机作最低限度改装，配置能够产生所需粒径的雾化喷嘴，即可形成典型平均产品粒径≤10微米的颗粒；且
text.en: f.2. The ability to generate a typical mean product particle size of ≤10 micrometers with existing fittings or by minimal modification of the spray-dryer with atomization nozzles enabling generation of the required particle size; and

text.zh: f.3. 能进行原位灭菌或消毒。
text.en: f.3. Capable of being sterilized or disinfected in situ.

text.zh: g. 如下防护和密闭设备：
text.en: g. Protective and containment equipment, as follows:

text.zh: g.1. 依靠管路连接的外部气源、在正压下工作的全身或半身防护服或头罩。
text.en: g.1. Protective full or half suits, or hoods dependent upon a tethered external air supply and operating under positive pressure.

text.zh: 2B352.g.1技术注释：
text.en: Technical Note to 2B352.g.1:

text.zh: 2B352.g.1不管制设计与自给式呼吸器配合穿戴的防护服。
text.en: 2B352.g.1 does not control suits designed to be worn with self-contained breathing apparatus.

text.zh: g.2. 正常运行时具有以下全部特性的生物密闭室、隔离器或生物安全柜：
text.en: g.2. Biocontainment chambers, isolators, or biological safety cabinets having all of the following characteristics, for normal operation:

text.zh: g.2.a. 工作空间完全封闭，操作人员通过实体屏障与工作区隔离；
text.en: g.2.a. Fully enclosed workspace where the operator is separated from the work by a physical barrier;

text.zh: g.2.b. 能在负压下运行；
text.en: g.2.b. Able to operate at negative pressure;

text.zh: g.2.c. 具有安全操纵工作空间内物项的装置；且
text.en: g.2.c. Means to safely manipulate items in the workspace; and

text.zh: g.2.d. 工作空间的送风和排风均经过高效空气颗粒（HEPA）过滤。
text.en: g.2.d. Supply and exhaust air to and from the workspace is high-efficiency particulate air (HEPA) filtered.
Note 1 to 2B352.g.2:

text.zh: 2B352.g.2管制世界卫生组织《实验室生物安全手册》（第3版，日内瓦，2004年）所规定，或依照国家标准、法规或指南建造的III级生物安全柜。
text.en: 2B352.g.2 controls class III biosafety cabinets, as specified in the WHO Laboratory Biosafety Manual (3rd edition, Geneva, 2004) or constructed in accordance with national standards, regulations or guidance.
Note 2 to 2B352.g.2:

text.zh: 2B352.g.2管制具有2B352.g.2.a至g.2.d所述全部特性的任何隔离器，无论其预期用途或名称为何，但为隔离护理或运送感染患者“专门设计”的医疗隔离器除外。
text.en: 2B352.g.2 controls any isolator having all of the characteristics described in 2B352.g.2.a through g.2.d, regardless of its intended use and its designation, except for medical isolators “specially designed” for barrier nursing or transportation of infected patients.

text.zh: h. 设计用于以微生物、病毒或毒素进行气溶胶挑战试验的如下气溶胶吸入设备：
text.en: h. Aerosol inhalation equipment designed for aerosol challenge testing with microorganisms, viruses or toxins, as follows:

text.zh: h.1. 容量为1立方米或以上的全身暴露室；
text.en: h.1. Whole-body exposure chambers having a capacity of 1 cubic meter or greater;

text.zh: h.2. 采用定向气溶胶流、能够使12只或以上啮齿动物或两只或以上非啮齿动物暴露的仅鼻部暴露装置，以及设计与此类装置配合使用的封闭式动物固定管。
text.en: h.2. Nose-only exposure apparatus utilizing directed aerosol flow and having a capacity for the exposure of 12 or more rodents, or two or more animals other than rodents, and closed animal restraint tubes designed for use with such apparatus.

text.zh: i. 如下喷洒或雾化系统及其“零件”和“部件”：
text.en: i. Spraying or fogging systems and “parts” and “components” therefor, as follows:

text.zh: i.1. 为安装于航空器、“轻于空气的飞行器”或“无人航空器”上“专门设计”或改装的完整喷洒或雾化系统，能够以大于每分钟2升的流量，从液态悬浮液产生初始液滴“VMD”小于50微米的喷雾；
text.en: i.1. Complete spraying or fogging systems, “specially designed” or modified for fitting to aircraft, “lighter than air vehicles,” or “UAVs,” capable of delivering, from a liquid suspension, an initial droplet “VMD” of less than 50 microns at a flow rate of greater than 2 liters per minute;

text.zh: i.2. 为安装于航空器、“轻于空气的飞行器”或“无人航空器”上“专门设计”或改装的喷杆或气溶胶发生单元阵列，能够以大于每分钟2升的流量，从液态悬浮液产生初始液滴“VMD”小于50微米的喷雾；
text.en: i.2. Spray booms or arrays of aerosol generating units, “specially designed” or modified for fitting to aircraft, “lighter than air vehicles,” or “UAVs,” capable of delivering, from a liquid suspension, an initial droplet “VMD” of less than 50 microns at a flow rate of greater than 2 liters per minute;

text.zh: i.3. 为安装于本ECCN i.1及i.2项所列系统上“专门设计”的气溶胶发生单元。
text.en: i.3. Aerosol generating units “specially designed” for fitting to the systems as specified in paragraphs i.1 and i.2 of this ECCN.

text.zh: 2B352.i技术注释：
text.en: Technical Notes to 2B352.i:

text.zh: 1. 气溶胶发生单元是为安装于航空器上“专门设计”或改装的装置，包括喷嘴、旋转鼓式雾化器及类似装置。
text.en: 1. Aerosol generating units are devices “specially designed” or modified for fitting to aircraft and include nozzles, rotary drum atomizers and similar devices.

text.zh: 2. 本ECCN不管制2B352.i所列、经证明不能以感染性气溶胶形式散播生物战剂的喷洒或雾化系统、“零件”和“部件”。
text.en: 2. This ECCN does not control spraying or fogging systems, “parts” and “components,” as specified in 2B352.i, that are demonstrated not to be capable of delivering biological agents in the form of infectious aerosols.

text.zh: 3. 为航空器或“无人航空器”“专门设计”的喷洒设备或喷嘴，其液滴粒径应使用以下任一方法测量（在国际公认标准获采用之前）：
text.en: 3. Droplet size for spray equipment or nozzles “specially designed” for use on aircraft or “UAVs” should be measured using either of the following methods (pending the adoption of internationally accepted standards):

text.zh: a. 多普勒激光法；
text.en: a. Doppler laser method,

text.zh: b. 前向激光衍射法。
text.en: b. Forward laser diffraction method.

text.zh: j. 同时符合以下两项条件的核酸组装仪和合成仪：
text.en: j. Nucleic acid assemblers and synthesizers that are both:

text.zh: j.1. 部分或全部自动化；且
text.en: j.1 Partly or entirely automated; and

text.zh: j.2. 设计能在单次运行中生成长度大于1.5千碱基、错误率小于5%的连续核酸。
text.en: j.2. Designed to generate continuous nucleic acids greater than 1.5 kilobases in length with error rates less than 5% in a single run.

text.zh: k. 同时符合以下两项条件的肽合成仪：
text.en: k. Peptide synthesizers that are both:

text.zh: k.1. 部分或全部自动化；且
text.en: k.1 Partly or entirely automated; and

text.zh: k.2. 能以1 mmol或更大的“系统合成规模”生成肽。
text.en: k.2 Capable of generating peptides at a 'system synthesis scale' of 1 mmol or greater.

text.zh: 2B352.k技术注释：
text.en: Technical Note to 2B352.k:

text.zh: “系统合成规模”指仪器使用最大兼容反应容器（L）所能生产的肽的最大量（mmol）。对于并行生产的多种肽，该规模按最大兼容反应容器（L）的总和确定。
text.en: 'System synthesis scale' denotes the maximum amount of peptide (mmol) that can be produced by the instrument using the largest compatible reaction vessels (L). For multiple peptides produced in parallel, this is the sum of the largest compatible reaction vessels (L).

text.zh: .k项注意：
text.en: N.B. to paragraph .k:

text.zh: 其他化学反应容器或反应器见ECCN 2B350。
text.en: See ECCN 2B350 for other chemical reaction vessels or reactors.

text.zh: 物项：
text.en: Items:

text.zh: a. 至少具有以下一种固结能量源：
text.en: a. Having at least one of the following consolidation sources:
a.1. “Laser”;

text.zh: a.2. 电子束；或
text.en: a.2. Electron beam; or

text.zh: a.3. 电弧；
text.en: a.3. Electric arc;

text.zh: b. 具有以下任一种受控工艺气氛：
text.en: b. Having a controlled process atmosphere of any of the following:

text.zh: b.1. 惰性气体；或
text.en: b.1. Inert gas; or

text.zh: b.2. 真空（等于或小于100 Pa）；
text.en: b.2. Vacuum (equal to or less than 100 Pa);

text.zh: c. 具有采用“同轴配置”或“旁轴配置”的以下任一“过程监测”设备：
text.en: c. Having any of the following 'in-process monitoring' equipment in a 'co-axial configuration' or 'paraxial configuration':

text.zh: c.1. 峰值响应波长大于380 nm且不超过14,000 nm的成像相机；
text.en: c.1. Imaging camera with a peak response in the wavelength range exceeding 380 nm but not exceeding 14,000 nm;

text.zh: c.2. 设计用于测量大于1,273.15K（1,000 °C）温度的高温计；或
text.en: c.2. Pyrometer designed to measure temperatures greater than 1,273.15K (1,000 °C); or

text.zh: c.3. 峰值响应波长大于380 nm且不超过3,000 nm的辐射计或光谱仪；且
text.en: c.3. Radiometer or spectrometer with a peak response in the wavelength range exceeding 380 nm but not exceeding 3,000 nm; and

text.zh: d. 具有闭环控制系统，设计用于在成形周期中，根据2B910.c所列“过程监测”设备的反馈，修改固结能量源参数、成形路径或设备设置。
text.en: d. A closed loop control system designed to modify the consolidation source parameters, build path, or equipment settings during the build cycle in response to feedback from 'in-process monitoring' equipment specified in 2B910.c.

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Notes:

text.zh: 就2B910而言：
text.en: For the purposes of 2B910:

text.zh: 1. “过程监测”（亦称原位过程监测）指对增材制造过程进行观察和测量，包括熔池发出的电磁或热辐射。
text.en: 1. 'In-process monitoring', also known as in-situ process monitoring, pertains to the observation and measurement of the additive manufacturing process including electromagnetic, or thermal, emissions from the melt pool.

text.zh: 2. “同轴配置”（亦称轴上或共线配置）指一个或多个传感器安装在与“激光”固结能量源共用的光路上。
text.en: 2. 'Co-axial configuration', also known as on-axis or inline configuration, pertains to one or more sensors that are mounted in an optical path shared by the “laser” consolidation source.

text.zh: 3. “旁轴配置”指一个或多个传感器实体安装于或集成于“激光”、电子束或电弧固结能量源部件。
text.en: 3. 'Paraxial configuration' pertains to one or more sensors that are physically mounted onto or integrated into the “laser”, electron beam, or electric arc consolidation source component.

text.zh: 4. 对于“同轴配置”和“旁轴配置”，传感器的视场均固定于固结能量源的移动参照系，并在整个成形过程中沿与固结能量源相同的扫描轨迹移动。
text.en: 4. For both 'co-axial configuration' and 'paraxial configuration', the field of view of the sensor(s) is fixed to the moving reference frame of the consolidation source and moves in the same scan trajectories of the consolidation source throughout the build process.

text.zh: 物项：a. 机床“数控”单元：
text.en: Items: a. “Numerical control” units for machine tools:

text.zh: a.1. 具有四个可同时协调进行“轮廓控制”的插补轴；或
text.en: a.1. Having four interpolating axes that can be coordinated simultaneously for “contouring control;” or

text.zh: a.2. 具有两个或以上可同时协调进行“轮廓控制”的轴，且最小可编程增量优于（小于）0.001 mm；
text.en: a.2. Having two or more axes that can be coordinated simultaneously for “contouring control” and a minimum programmable increment better (less) than 0.001 mm;

text.zh: a.3. 具有两个、三个或四个可同时协调进行“轮廓控制”的插补轴，且能直接（在线）接收并处理计算机辅助设计（CAD）数据以在内部编制机床指令的机床“数控”单元；或
text.en: a.3. “Numerical control” units for machine tools having two, three or four interpolating axes that can be coordinated simultaneously for “contouring control,” and capable of receiving directly (on-line) and processing computer-aided-design (CAD) data for internal preparation of machine instructions; or

text.zh: b. 为机床“专门设计”且具有以下任一特性的“运动控制板”：
text.en: b. “Motion control boards” “specially designed” for machine tools and having any of the following characteristics:

text.zh: b.1. 可进行四个以上轴的插补；
text.en: b.1. Interpolation in more than four axes;

text.zh: b.2. 能通过以下任一方式对数据进行“实时处理”，在加工过程中修改刀具路径、进给速率和主轴数据：
text.en: b.2. Capable of “real-time processing” of data to modify tool path, feed rate and spindle data, during the machining operation, by any of the following:

text.zh: b.2.a. 通过测量循环及访问源数据，自动计算并修改用于两个或以上轴加工的零件程序数据；或
text.en: b.2.a. Automatic calculation and modification of part program data for machining in two or more axes by means of measuring cycles and access to source data; or

text.zh: b.2.b. “自适应控制”，测量一个以上物理变量，并通过计算模型（策略）处理，以更改一条或多条加工指令来优化过程。
text.en: b.2.b. “Adaptive control” with more than one physical variable measured and processed by means of a computing model (strategy) to change one or more machining instructions to optimize the process.

text.zh: b.3. 能接收和处理CAD数据以在内部编制机床指令；或
text.en: b.3. Capable of receiving and processing CAD data for internal preparation of machine instructions; or

text.zh: c. 按制造商技术规格，可配备电子装置以在两个或以上轴上同时进行“轮廓控制”，并同时具有以下两项特性的“数控”机床：
text.en: c. “Numerically controlled” machine tools that, according to the manufacturer's technical specifications, can be equipped with electronic devices for simultaneous “contouring control” in two or more axes and that have both of the following characteristics:

text.zh: c.1. 具有两个或以上可同时协调进行轮廓控制的轴；且
text.en: c.1. Two or more axes that can be coordinated simultaneously for contouring control; and

text.zh: c.2. 根据ISO 230/2（2006），在启用所有可用补偿时，定位精度如下：
text.en: c.2. Positioning accuracies according to ISO 230/2 (2006), with all compensations available:

text.zh: c.2.a. 对于磨床，沿任一直线轴的定位精度（总定位）优于15 µm；
text.en: c.2.a. Better than 15 µm along any linear axis (overall positioning) for grinding machines;

text.zh: c.2.b. 对于铣床，沿任一直线轴的定位精度（总定位）优于15 µm；或
text.en: c.2.b. Better than 15 µm along any linear axis (overall positioning) for milling machines; or

text.zh: c.2.c. 对于车床，沿任一直线轴的定位精度（总定位）优于15 µm；或
text.en: c.2.c. Better than 15 µm along any linear axis (overall positioning) for turning machines; or

text.zh: d. 用于去除或切削金属、陶瓷或复合材料，且按制造商技术规格可配备电子装置以在两个或以上轴上同时进行“轮廓控制”的如下机床：
text.en: d. Machine tools, as follows, for removing or cutting metals, ceramics or composites, that, according to the manufacturer's technical specifications, can be equipped with electronic devices for simultaneous “contouring control” in two or more axes:

text.zh: d.1. 用于车削、磨削、铣削或其任何组合，具有两个或以上可同时协调进行“轮廓控制”的轴，且具有以下任一特性的机床：
text.en: d.1. Machine tools for turning, grinding, milling or any combination thereof, having two or more axes that can be coordinated simultaneously for “contouring control” and having any of the following characteristics:

text.zh: d.1.a. 具有一个或多个轮廓控制“倾斜主轴”；
text.en: d.1.a. One or more contouring “tilting spindles;”

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 2B991.d.1.a仅适用于磨削或铣削机床。
text.en: 2B991.d.1.a. applies to machine tools for grinding or milling only.

text.zh: d.1.b. 主轴旋转一周的轴向“窜动”（轴向位移）小于（优于）0.0006 mm总指示读数（TIR）；
text.en: d.1.b. “Camming” (axial displacement) in one revolution of the spindle less (better) than 0.0006 mm total indicator reading (TIR);

text.zh: 注：
text.en: Note:

text.zh: 2B991.d.1.b仅适用于车削机床。
text.en: 2B991.d.1.b. applies to machine tools for turning only.

text.zh: d.1.c. 主轴旋转一周的径向“跳动”（旋转偏差）小于（优于）0.0006 mm总指示读数（TIR）；
text.en: d.1.c. “Run out” (out-of-true running) in one revolution of the spindle less (better) than 0.0006 mm total indicator reading (TIR);

text.zh: d.1.d. 在启用所有可用补偿时，任一旋转轴的“定位精度”小于（优于）0.001°；
text.en: d.1.d. The “positioning accuracies”, with all compensations available, are less (better) than: 0.001° on any rotary axis;

text.zh: d.2. 具有五个或以上可同时协调进行“轮廓控制”的轴的送丝式电火花加工机床（EDM）。
text.en: d.2. Electrical discharge machines (EDM) of the wire feed type that have five or more axes that can be coordinated simultaneously for “contouring control.”

text.zh: 物项：a. 使用单点切削刀具，且具有以下全部特性的车床：
text.en: Items: a. Turning machines using a single point cutting tool and having all of the following characteristics:

text.zh: a.1. 每300 mm行程的滑座定位精度小于（优于）0.0005 mm；
text.en: a.1. Slide positioning accuracy less (better) than 0.0005 mm per 300 mm of travel;

text.zh: a.2. 每300 mm行程的滑座双向定位重复性小于（优于）0.00025 mm；
text.en: a.2. Bidirectional slide positioning repeatability less (better) than 0.00025 mm per 300 mm of travel;

text.zh: a.3. 主轴径向“跳动”和轴向“窜动”小于（优于）0.0004 mm总指示读数（TIR）；
text.en: a.3. Spindle “run out” and “camming” less (better) than 0.0004 mm total indicator reading (TIR);

text.zh: a.4. 全行程内滑座运动的角偏差（偏航、俯仰和滚转）小于（优于）2角秒（TIR）；且
text.en: a.4. Angular deviation of the slide movement (yaw, pitch and roll) less (better) than 2 seconds of arc, TIR, over full travel; and

text.zh: a.5. 每300 mm行程的滑座垂直度误差小于（优于）0.001 mm；
text.en: a.5. Slide perpendicularity less (better) than 0.001 mm per 300 mm of travel;

text.zh: 技术注：
text.en: Technical Note:

text.zh: 某轴的滑座双向定位重复性（R），指使用ISO 230/2:1988第2.11部分规定的程序和条件，在沿该轴或绕该轴任何位置确定的定位重复性的最大值。
text.en: The bidirectional slide positioning repeatability (R) of an axis is the maximum value of the repeatability of positioning at any position along or around the axis determined using the procedure and under the conditions specified in part 2.11 of ISO 230/2: 1988.

text.zh: b. 具有以下全部特性的飞刀切削机床：

text.en: b.1. Spindle “run out” and “camming” less (better) than 0.0004 mm TIR; and

text.zh: b.2. 全行程内滑座运动的角偏差（偏航、俯仰及滚转）小于（优于）2角秒（TIR）。
text.en: b.2. Angular deviation of slide movement (yaw, pitch and roll) less (better) than 2 seconds of arc, TIR, over full travel.
